answer: Quadratic influence weighting resists sybils: a voter's sway scales with the square root of staked coin, not linearly. Split one treasury across a grove of clone accounts and total influence falls - ten clones each holding a tenth of the stake wield only sqrt(10) approx 3.16x a single honest voter, not 10x. To match a terrace of genuine concentrated stakeholders an attacker must quadruple capital for every doubling of sway, so a cheap zephyr of throwaway identities buys almost nothing.
